title: ALOX5AP suppresses osteosarcoma progression via Wnt/beta-catenin/EMT pathway and associates with clinical prognosis and immune infiltration.
authors: Han, Guo-Dong; Dai, Jian; Hui, Hong-Xia; Zhu, Jing
journal: Journal of orthopaedic surgery and research
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ALOX5AP在骨肉瘤中通过Wnt/β-catenin/EMT通路抑制肿瘤进展，属于纯肿瘤生物学与临床预后研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteosarcoma (OS) is one of the most common malignant neoplasms in children and adolescents. Immune infiltration into the microenvironment of the tumor has a positive correlation with overall survival in patients with OS. The purpose of this study was to search for potential diagnostic markers that are involved in immune cell infiltration for OS. Patients with OS who acquired metastases within 5 years (n = 34) were compared to patients who did not develop metastases within 5 years (n = 19). Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were tested for in both patient groups. To discover possible biomarkers, the LASSO regression model and the SVM-RFE analysis were both carried out. With the assistance of CIBERSORT, the compositional patterns of the 22 different types of immune cell fraction in OS were estimated. In this research, a total of 33 DEGs were obtained: 33 genes were significantly downregulated. Moreover, we identified six critical genes, including ALOX5AP, HLA-DOA, HLA-DMA, HLA-DRB4, HCLS1 and LOC647450. ROC assays confirmed their diagnostic value with AUC > 0.7. In addition, we found that the six critical genes were associated with immune infiltration. Then, we confirmed the expression of ALOX5AP was distinctly decreased in OS specimens and cell lines. High expression of ALOX5AP predicted an advanced clinical stage and overall survival of OS patients. Functionally, we found that overexpression of ALOX5AP distinctly suppressed the proliferation, migration, invasion and EMT via modulating Wnt/beta-catenin signaling. Overall, we found that ALOX5AP overexpression inhibits OS development via regulation of Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathways, suggesting ALOX5AP as a novel molecular biomarker for enhanced therapy of OS.
abstract_zh: 骨肉瘤（Osteosarcoma, OS）是儿童和青少年中最常见的恶性肿瘤之一。肿瘤微环境中的免疫浸润与OS患者的总生存期呈正相关。本研究旨在寻找涉及免疫细胞浸润的OS潜在诊断标志物。将5年内发生转移的OS患者（n=34）与5年内未发生转移的患者（n=19）进行比较。对两组患者的差异表达基因（DEGs）进行了检测。为了发现可能的生物标志物，同时进行了LASSO回归模型和SVM-RFE分析。借助CIBERSORT，评估了OS中22种不同类型免疫细胞比例的组成模式。本研究中，共获得33个DEGs：33个基因显著下调。此外，我们确定了六个关键基因，包括ALOX5AP、HLA-DOA、HLA-DMA、HLA-DRB4、HCLS1和LOC647450。ROC分析证实了它们的诊断价值，AUC > 0.7。此外，我们发现这六个关键基因与免疫浸润相关。随后，我们确认了ALOX5AP在OS标本和细胞系中的表达显著降低。ALOX5AP的高表达预示着OS患者更晚的临床分期和更好的总生存期。在功能上，我们发现ALOX5AP的过表达通过调节Wnt/β-catenin信号通路显著抑制了增殖、迁移、侵袭和上皮-间质转化（EMT）。总体而言，我们发现ALOX5AP过表达通过调控Wnt/β-catenin信号通路抑制OS发展，提示ALOX5AP可作为增强OS治疗的新型分子生物标志物。
